one_liner: Extracts text, tables, and detailed char/line/rect geometry from PDFs, built on pdfminer.six.
provides: ["pdfplumber.open(path) -> PDF; page.extract_text() / extract_words()", "page.extract_table()/extract_tables() with configurable table strategies", "Per-object access: page.chars/lines/rects/curves/images with bbox geometry", "Visual debugging: page.to_image() for cropping/inspection", "Geometry utilities (bbox/clustering/edges) in pdfplumber.utils", "repair() to fix malformed PDFs"]
requires: ["(manifest-enforced) PyPI 'pdfplumber'; hard dep pdfminer.six (text extraction engine) + Pillow (images)", "(readme-asserted) to_image()/visual debugging needs an ImageMagick/Ghostscript-backed image stack", "(readme-asserted) Python 3 (no requires_python pinned in the shown manifests)"]
assumptions: ["text-based PDFs (no OCR; scanned images yield no text)", "pdfminer.six installed automatically as a dependency", "optional image tooling present for to_image()"]
recipe: {"install": "pip install pdfplumber", "wire": ["import pdfplumber", "with pdfplumber.open('doc.pdf') as pdf:", "    page = pdf.pages[0]; text = page.extract_text(); tables = page.extract_tables()"]}
surface: medium - PDF/page objects + extraction + geometry utils
